{"script":"cat > ~/exp_count.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Count regular files and directories inside $HOME/exp_folder (excluding the folder itself)
dir="$HOME/exp_folder"
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  echo 0
  exit 0
fi
files=$(find "$dir" -type f | wc -l)
dirs=$(find "$dir" -mindepth 1 -type d | wc -l)
sum=$((files + dirs))
# Output only the sum as required
echo "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x ~/exp_count.sh
printf "Created ~/exp_count.sh\n---\n"
cat ~/exp_count.sh
"}
